question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the given group of words.

the husks of corn or other grains separated by winnowing or threshing.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"chaff"** refers to the husks of corn or other grains separated by winnowing or threshing. (भूसी) • Example:** **The farmer used a winnowing fan to separate the ***chaff*** from the wheat. • Example : we used to come in for a fair amount of ribbing and good-natured ***chaff***. Therefore, the correct substitution of the given statement is '***Chaff.'*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Peel **(छिलका): The outer skin or covering of a fruit or vegetable. • **Example:** She carefully* ****peeled* **the apple before slicing it. • **Hay **(घास): Grass that has been mown and dried for use as fodder. • **Example: **The farmer stored*** hay ***in the barn for the winter. • **Fodder** (चारा): Food, especially dried hay or feed, for cattle and other livestock. • **Example:** The cattle were fed with fresh ***fodder ***every morning. a4:Tcc3,
